  • goroutine:

@ECHO OFF
PUSHD .

SET SCRIPT_DIR=%~dp0
set JAVA_CMD=%UNM_ROOT%\platform\jre in\java
set JAVAW_CMD=%UNM_ROOT%\platform\jre in\javaw

CD "%SCRIPT_DIR%\.."
FOR /F %%I IN ('CD') DO SET ROOT_DIR=%%I

FOR /F %%I IN ('TYPE "%ROOT_DIR% in\jarfile"') DO SET PACKAGE_NAME=%%I
set MAIN_CLASS=com.fiberhome.service.TelemetryServiceEntry
echo %MAIN_CLASS%
TITLE %PACKAGE_NAME%
if "%1" neq "" (
  start /b %JAVAW_CMD% -DExtYmlUrl="%1" -jar "%ROOT_DIR%\lib\%PACKAGE_NAME%"
) else (
  start /b %JAVAW_CMD% -jar "%ROOT_DIR%\lib\%PACKAGE_NAME%" 
)
exit
::CALL java -jar "%ROOT_DIR%\lib\%PACKAGE_NAME%"

POPD

::set path=%node_path%;C:\Program Files\WinRAR;%path%

echo tool_folder%tool_folder%

call node -v

echo "-----check npm version-----"
call npm -v

    )

:end
echo "-----end build-2.bat-----"

# Android kernel
## Compilation
The Android kernel source code is located in the `BST-C1200-LINUX-SDK-Vx.x.x.x-Release/opensource_code` directory as `kernel_android_xxxxxxxxx.tar.gz`. Refer to the [SDK installation](../../quickstart_en/sdk_userguide/sdk-install.md) section for instructions on installing container image dependencies. After setting up the FDK, DDK, and SDK container development environment, copy the source code archive into the container and execute the following commands to compile:

```shell
source /opt/bstos/linux-25/environment-setup-aarch64-bst-linux
./make_c1200_android.sh
```

The generated image, dtb, and defconfig files are located at:

```shell
build/arch/arm64/boot/Image
build/arch/arm64/boot/dts/bst/bstc1200-ivi.dtb
arch/arm64/configs/bstc1200_ivi_defconfig
```

# Android kernel
## Compilation
The Android kernel source code is located in the `BST-C1200-LINUX-SDK-Vx.x.x.x-Release/opensource_code` directory as `kernel_android_xxxxxxxxx.tar.gz`. Refer to the [SDK installation](../../quickstart_en/sdk_userguide/sdk-install.md) section for instructions on installing container image dependencies. After setting up the FDK, DDK, and SDK container development environment, copy the source code archive into the container and execute the following commands to compile:

```shell
source /opt/bstos/linux-25/environment-setup-aarch64-bst-linux
./make_c1200_android.sh
```

The generated image, dtb, and defconfig files are located at:

```shell
build/arch/arm64/boot/Image
build/arch/arm64/boot/dts/bst/bstc1200-ivi.dtb
arch/arm64/configs/bstc1200_ivi_defconfig
```

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

SCRIPT_DIR=$(dirname $(readlink -f "$0"))
IS_COPY=$1

#加载python环境,持续集成已经设置python环境,不需要再进行设置
#source $UNM_ROOT/server/tool/unmvars.sh

cd $SCRIPT_DIR

#编译前端代码
echo -------build frontend app begin----------
python build_nmtool_web/build_nmtool_web.py
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
	echo "build nmtool_web failed"
	exit -1
else
	echo "build nmtool_web success"
fi
echo -------build frontend app end------------

#编译后端代码
chmod 777 build_unm_cm_service.sh
sh build_unm_cm_service.sh
exit_status_cm=$?
echo $exit_status_cm
if [ $exit_status_cm -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "build_unm_cm_service failed"
  exit -1
fi

#拷贝到网管环境
if [ $IS_COPY == "true" ];
then
	chmod 777 copy_to_unm2000.sh
	sh copy_to_unm2000.sh
	chmod 777 make_nmtool_src.sh
	sh make_nmtool_src.sh
fi

#!/bin/bash
cd /opt/unm2000/script
serverip=0.0.0.0 
installdir=/opt/unm2000
slaveip=0.0.0.0
lang=1
dbtype=1
deploymode=1
nodename=
while read line || [[ -n ${line} ]]
do
	if [[ $line =~ "CentrializedIP=" ]]
	then
		export serverip=${line##*CentrializedIP=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "UnmInstallPath=" ]]
	then
		export installdir=${line##*UnmInstallPath=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "DisSlaveIp=" ]]
	then
		export slaveip=${line##*DisSlaveIp=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "Language=" ]]
	then
		export lang=${line##*Language=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "dbtype=" ]]
	then
		export dbtype=${line##*dbtype=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "dbport=" ]]
	then
		export dbport=${line##*dbport=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "DeployMode=" ]]
	then
		export deploymode=${line##*DeployMode=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "HostName=" ]]
	then
		export nodename=${line##*HostName=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "Document=" ]]
	then
		export document=${line##*Document=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "NBIServer=" ]]
	then
		export nbiserver=${line##*NBIServer=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "SDNServer=" ]]
	then
		export sdnserver=${line##*SDNServer=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "ServerOption=" ]]
	then
		export serveroption=${line##*ServerOption=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "ClientOption=" ]]
	then
		export clientoption=${line##*ClientOption=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "architecture=" ]]
	then
		export architecture=${line##*architecture=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "hostNo=" ]]
	then
		export hostno=${line##*hostNo=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "isNBINode=" ]]
	then
		export isnbinode=${line##*isNBINode=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "dbIp=" ]]
	then
		export dbip=${line##*dbIp=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "poenable=" ]]
	then
		export poenable=${line##*poenable=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "pasCalcNum=" ]]
	then
		export pascalcnum=${line##*pasCalcNum=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "pasDbIp=" ]]
	then
		export pasdbip=${line##*pasDbIp=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "registryIp=" ]]

		export registryip=${line##*registryIp=}
	fi

	then
		export emstype=${line##*emsType=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "localIp=" ]]
	then
		export localip=${line##*localIp=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "abstractneserverNum=" ]]
	then
		export abstractneservernum=${line##*abstractneserverNum=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "UnmSingleinstall=" ]]
	then
		export unmsingleinstall=${line##*UnmSingleinstall=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "randompwd_flg=" ]]
	then
		export randompwd_flg=${line##*randompwd_flg=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "randompwd_str=" ]]
	then
		export randompwd_str=${line##*randompwd_str=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "ipv6=" ]]
	then
		export ipv6=${line##*ipv6=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "isIgniteMode=" ]]
	then
		export isignitemode=${line##*isIgniteMode=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "customerConfigXmlSourceFile=" ]]
	then
		export customerconfigxmlsourcefile=${line##*customerConfigXmlSourceFile=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "customerConfigXmlTargetFile=" ]]
	then
		export customerconfigxmltargetfile=${line##*customerConfigXmlTargetFile=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "pasDbMode=" ]]
	then
		export pasdbmode=${line##*pasDbMode=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "pasDbPort=" ]]
	then
		export pasdbport=${line##*pasDbPort=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "igniteServerAddr=" ]]
	then
		export igniteserveraddr=${line##*igniteServerAddr=}
	fi
done < $installdir/unm2000install.ini
